question: The radius and height of a cylinder are 28 cm and 40 cm, respectively. Find its volume.
solution:
**Given:**

Radius (r) = 28 cm

Height (h) = 40 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume (V) = πr²h

**Calculations:**

⇒ V = (22/7) × (28)² × 40

⇒ V = (22/7) × 784 × 40

⇒ V = (22/7) × 31360

⇒ V = (22 × 31360) / 7

⇒ V = 689920 / 7

⇒ V = 98560 cm³

**∴ The volume of the cylinder is 98560 cm³.**
